zh.title: 洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）空廚遭指衛生不良服務15家航司
zh.summary: 洛杉磯國際機場一空廚業者遭指衛生不良；服務至少15家航空公司；正接受調查檢視
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，位於美國洛杉磯國際機場的一家航空餐飲供應商，目前正因衛生與工作環境相關指控而面臨各方審查與檢視。該公司主要負責為當地至少 15 家航空公司提供機上餐點服務。
根據指控內容，該餐飲供應商的營運設施被舉報涉及霉菌、蛆蟲以及蟑螂等衛生問題。這些關於不良衛生條件與環境的嚴重指控，使該公司的餐點服務與內部營運狀況受到關切。
目前該家服務至少 15 家航空公司的洛杉磯國際機場空廚業者，因不良衛生條件及工作環境指控而持續面臨關切與審查。

en.title: LAX (LAX) Caterer Serving 15 Airlines Faces Hygiene Allegations
en.summary: LAX airline caterer serving 15 carriers faces scrutiny over allegations of mold, maggots, and poor conditions.
body: An airline catering company supplying in-flight meal services to at least 15 airlines at Los Angeles International Airport  is under scrutiny following allegations concerning its hygiene practices and working conditions.

The allegations against the Los Angeles International Airport catering provider specifically cite problems involving mold, maggots, and cockroaches. The company serves multiple air carriers operating out of the major California hub.

Due to the reported hygiene issues and working environment claims, the catering company remains under scrutiny regarding its food preparation operations and workplace standards for the 15 airlines it supplies at LAX.

zh.title: 美軍兩架KC135加油機提前撤離保加利亞基地
zh.summary: 美軍兩架KC-135加油機已於8月21日撤離保更正空軍基地，較授權期滿提前。
body: 美國空軍已將兩架KC-135空中加油機從保加利亞的Bezmer空軍基地撤離，結束了一次曾引發伊朗強烈批評的部署。
據保加利亞國防部長迪米特爾·斯托亞諾夫（Dimitar Stoyanov）表示，加油機於2026年8月21日離境，距離授權到期（2026年10月初）提前了數週。
美國駐歐洲空軍與非洲空軍司令部在週末確認了撤離行動，表示加油機離開是為了支援「其他作戰需求」。
這兩架加油機於2026年7月31日抵達BOB保加利亞，此前美國國會於7月22日批准部署，授權最多放8架KC-135和250人，部署期為2026年7月24日至10月1日。

en.title: US withdraws two KC-135 tankers from Bulgaria's Bezmer Air Base (JAM) ahead of schedule
en.summary: Two KC-135 tankers left Bezmer Air Base on Aug 21, weeks before authorization expiry, UAE confirmed.
body: The US Air Force has taken out two KC-135 Stratotanker refueling aircraft from Bezmer Air Base in Bulgaria, ending to a deployment that drew criticism from Iran.

The tankers departed on August 21, 2026, weeks ahead of the authorized expiration in early October 2026, according to Bulgarian Defense Minister Dimitar Stoyanov, as reported by the Bulgarian News Agency.
US Air Forces in Europe-Air Forces Africa confirmed the departure over the weekend, saying the tankers left to support other operational requirements.

The KC-135s had arrived in Bulgaria on July 31, 2026, after a request from the US Embassy, and Bulgaria's Parliament approved a deployment of up to eight KC-13 rockbreaking and 250 personnel beef there from July 24 through October 1, 2026.
